Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery (Status Pe.name: Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery (Status Penalty)
Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery (Status Pe.description: You take a -1 status penalty to your saves against Mark of Mystery's effect.

Effect: Familiar of Churning Saltwater.name: Effect: Familiar of Churning Saltwater
Effect: Familiar of Churning Saltwater.description: You take a -1 circumstance penalty to your Fortitude DC and AC against water effects.

Spell Effect: Lost in the Crowd.name: Spell Effect: Lost in the Crowd
Spell Effect: Lost in the Crowd.description: You treat all creatures as enemies for the purposes of determining flanking.

Spell Effect: Holding Glyph.name: Spell Effect: Holding Glyph
Spell Effect: Holding Glyph.description:
You take a status penalty against forced movement effects.

If your saving throw against the spell was a failure or worse, you additionally take @Damage[(@item.flags.pf2e.rulesSelections.holding * @item.level)[force]] damage when you use actions with the move trait.

Aura: Sanctum of Spirit.name: Aura: Sanctum of Spirit
Aura: Sanctum of Spirit.description: You and your allies inside the aura gain a +1 status bonus to saves and resistance to mental damage equal to your level. Creatures take a -2 circumstance penalty to attacks against you and allies within the sanctum as long as you or your allies have not taken a hostile action since the sanctum was created.

Effect: Bargain Soul.name: Effect: Bargain Soul
Effect: Bargain Soul.description: You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase these values by 1 if you already had them, and you gain a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against death effects.

Spell Effect: Cosmic Tune.name: Spell Effect: Cosmic Tune
Spell Effect: Cosmic Tune.description: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and Will saves, but you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the music. Hostile actions do not end the fascinated condition.

Effect: Familiar of Keen Senses.name: Effect: Familiar of Keen Senses
Effect: Familiar of Keen Senses.description: The target gains one of the following familiar abilities for one round: precise scent, tremorsense, or wavesense, with a range of 60 feet.

Spell Effect: Fabled Familiar.name: Spell Effect: Fabled Familiar
Spell Effect: Fabled Familiar.description: You gain a +1 status bonus to your next roll until the end of the caster's next turn.

Effect: Protection Circle.name: Effect: Protection Circle
Effect: Protection Circle.description: You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against effects from the chosen creatures as long as you and your allies remain in the area (+2 if you are legendary in your patron skill).

Ephemeral Effect: Sanctum of Spirit.name: Ephemeral Effect: Sanctum of Spirit
Ephemeral Effect: Sanctum of Spirit.description:
You take a -2 circumstance penalty to attacks against the creature you're targeting, because they or they allies have not taken a hostile action since the sanctum they're in was created.

Foundry Note You probably meant to grab @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.qLdSyaeVxUxp3mhn]{Effect: Sanctum of Spirit} (or more specifically @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.8Z1lbN4kP84vKcUq]{Aura: Sanctum of Spirit}), where the former secretly applies this effect to enemies attacking people who have them.

Spell Effect: Soothsayer's Prediction.name: Spell Effect: Soothsayer's Prediction
Spell Effect: Soothsayer's Prediction.description: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll.

Spell Effect: Brief Lesson.name: Spell Effect: Brief Lesson
Spell Effect: Brief Lesson.description: You gain trained or expert proficiency in a skill, and you gain an additional status bonus to checks with that skill for the duration.

Spell Effect: Sensory Deprivation.name: Spell Effect: Sensory Deprivation
Spell Effect: Sensory Deprivation.description:
Depending on the caster's choice, you feel a strange warmth and the inability to use certain actions, as your eyes, hands, or mouth are restricted.

  • Eyes You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.
  • Hands You cannot take actions with the manipulate trait.
  • Mouth You cannot take actions with the auditory trait.

Effect: Material Binding.name: Effect: Material Binding
Effect: Material Binding.description: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and a +2 circumstance bonus against forced movement or effects that would give you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} condition.

Effect: Familiar of Faraway Worlds.name: Effect: Familiar of Faraway Worlds
Effect: Familiar of Faraway Worlds.description: You gain a -1 status penalty to checks to disbelieve illusions.

Spell Effect: Aura of Violent Light.name: Spell Effect: Aura of Violent Light
Spell Effect: Aura of Violent Light.description:
You radiate bright light in an aura.

While illuminated, you radiate powerful energy that deals @Damage[(1+@item.level)[fire],(1+@item.level)[spirit]] damage to all enemies that end their turn within the bright light of the emanation (basic Fortitude save).

Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery.name: Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery
Spell Effect: Mark of Mystery.description:
You have the mark of the caster's patron on you. They can use your position when determining their mark's effect as well as theirs.

When you're targeted by a harmful effect while this spell is active, the creature targeting you must attempt a Will save against the spell. Creatures that fail their save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} if it was a critical failure.

Ephemeral Effect: Familiar of Murky Worl.name: Ephemeral Effect: Familiar of Murky Worlds
Ephemeral Effect: Familiar of Murky Worl.description:
The creature targeting you ignores your circumstance bonuses to AC due to cover.

Foundry Note You probably meant to grab @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.l15SCSWGttzPOPOO]{Effect: Familiar of Murky Worlds}, which secretly applies this effect to creatures you target.

Spell Effect: Grant Wish.name: Spell Effect: Grant Wish
Spell Effect: Grant Wish.description: You speak aloud a wish as a free action with the linguistic and auditory traits to give your next action or activity that requires an attack roll or a skill check a +1 status bonus to a single attack roll or skill check of your choice for that action or activity.

Spell Effect: Elemental Betrayal+.name: Spell Effect: Elemental Betrayal+
Spell Effect: Elemental Betrayal+.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.u17aLLTqu5O8UYFu]{Elemental Betrayal+}

When you Cast this Spell, choose air, earth, metal, fire, water, or wood. The target gains weakness to that trait.

Effect: Familiar of Murky Worlds.name: Effect: Familiar of Murky Worlds
Effect: Familiar of Murky Worlds.description: You ignore non-magical concealment and circumstance bonuses to AC due to cover for 1 round.

Effect: Monstrous Familiar.name: Effect: Monstrous Familiar
Effect: Monstrous Familiar.description:
Your familiar gains an additional 4 Hit Points for every level you have.

Foundry Note You must still apply the form spell's effect to the familiar in addition to this effect.

Effect: Spirited Reprisal.name: Effect: Spirited Reprisal
Effect: Spirited Reprisal.description: You gain resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 plus the caster's level.

Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Flood.name: Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Floods
Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Flood.description: You take a -2 penalty against forced movement and water effects.

Spell Effect: Demand Compliance.name: Spell Effect: Demand Compliance
Spell Effect: Demand Compliance.description: You take a status penalty to your attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.

Effect: Wayward Gifts.name: Effect: Wayward Gifts
Effect: Wayward Gifts.description:
While in an encounter and you have at least one hex active, you gain the listed effect depending on your tradition:

  • Arcane Your magic ripples with untamed power. You gain a +1 status bonus to Arcana checks and when you Cast a Spell from your spell slots that deals damage and doesn’t have a duration, you gain a status bonus to that spell’s damage equal to the spell’s rank.
  • Divine You gain the might of divinity. You gain a +1 status bonus to Religion checks and you gain either the holy trait or the unholy trait. If you follow a deity, you must choose the trait of your deity's divine sanctification if it requires one.
  • Occult You have begun your journey into some truly dark magick. You gain a +1 status bonus to Occultism checks and you gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
  • Primal Your magic is like that of a spirit of nature. You gain a +1 status bonus to Nature checks and you gain temporary Hit Points each time you Sustain a hex equal to its rank that last until the beginning of your next turn.

Foundry Note The temporary Hit Points from sustaining a hex for primal witches must be done manually.

Effect: Sanctum of Spirit.name: Effect: Sanctum of Spirit
Effect: Sanctum of Spirit.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-effects.Item.8Z1lbN4kP84vKcUq]{Aura: Sanctum of Spirit}

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves and resistance to mental damage equal to the level of the creature who is the aura's source. Creatures take a -2 circumstance penalty to attacks against you as long as you or your allies have not taken a hostile action since the sanctum was created.

Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Raptu.name: Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Rapture
Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Raptu.description: You ignore the damage from the area of the spell, and instead gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls while in it.

Effect: Familiar of Illogical Forms.name: Effect: Familiar of Illogical Forms
Effect: Familiar of Illogical Forms.description: The target gains one of the following familiar abilities for one round: amphibious, climber, darkvision, echolocation, gills, jet, levitator, or scent.

Spell Effect: Eternal Slumber.name: Spell Effect: Eternal Slumber
Spell Effect: Eternal Slumber.description:
On a success, you become drowsy and take a -2 status penalty to Perception checks to Seek and must attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:5] to use concentrate actions, losing the action on a failure.

On a failure, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} for the duration and do not automatically wake up under the circumstances that would cause you to wake unless you succeed at a Will save against the spell.

On a critical failure, you become unconscious permanently.

Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Frost.name: Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Frost
Spell Effect: Patron's Apocalypse: Frost.description: You take a -10 foot status penalty to your speeds.
